question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "pairs."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **
 

__
 
• The reason to use** "pairs"** in the blank is to specify the number of individual ear muffs. (जोड़े)
 
• The word** "pairs"** indicates that there are twenty sets of ear muffs, with each set consisting of two individual ear muffs.
 
• This usage clarifies that the count is based on complete pairs rather than individual units.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct paragraph:

Professor Sprout was standing behind__ a trestle bench in the centre of the greenhouse. __About__ twenty __**pairs**__ of different-coloured ear muffs ______ (4) ______ lying on the bench. Harry ______ (5) ______ his place between Ron and Hermione.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Couples: **two people who are together because they are married or in a relationship. (विवाहित होने अथवा किसी सम्बन्ध में होने के कारण दो व्यक्तियों का एक साध रहना, दंपत्ति, पति-पत्‍नी)
 
• **Duality: **the quality or condition of being dual. (दोहरे होने की गुणवत्ता या स्थिति)
 
• **Teams: **a group of people who perform interdependent tasks to work toward accomplishing a common mission or specific objective. (लोगों का एक समूह जो एक सामान्य मिशन या विशिष्ट उद्देश्य को पूरा करने की दिशा में अन्योन्याश्रित कार्य करता है)
